description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal migration source plugin class 'Block' for migrating block data from Drupal 6/7 databases. It includes methods for querying block data, initializing iteration, defining fields, and preparing data rows with block properties and settings.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for migrating block data from Drupal 6/7 databases.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Constructs and returns a database query to retrieve block data, adjusting table names based on schema version.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes theme variables before starting data iteration.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines the fields available in the data source, such as block ID, module, delta, theme, status, etc.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Specifies the unique identifiers for each block record, including module, delta, and theme.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by setting theme properties, roles, and module-specific settings based on block data.
